name: drobek-module-ops-probe
description: e2e fixture: an operator-only module (no skill) with an errors.reporter (ERROR_REPORTER=capture, OPSPROBE_URL), an email.transport (EMAIL_TRANSPORT=relay, OPSPROBE_MAIL_URL) and a server job, installed into the e2e stacks with selfhost-module.sh. Plain ESM, no build step.
